tip: Drag a jelly to the gate of its colour to send it out.
Jellies slide around each other. Order matters!
Big jellies only fit through gates as wide as they are.
Packed in! Slide jellies into the gap to make room, one move at a time.
Striped jellies only slide one way.
Frozen jellies thaw after that many others have left.
An icy gate opens after that many jellies have left.
Double jellies: the first gate peels the outside colour, then send the inside one out.
A chained jelly is free once the jelly with the matching key is gone.
Crates are in the way until that many jellies have left.
